purpose: side-effect-free client-function ABI/dispatcher probe; not a cheat

probe_contract.side_effects: none; does not read/write game state or files
probe_contract.numeric_storage_evidence: Pinned stock ARM64 libS3DClient.so: uai_gp_hud::onDebug entry VA 0x6d5048 loads the value at AIVariable offset +8 with LDR D8, and compares it using FP64 instructions. This supports a binary64 payload model but does not replace the absent SDK header or live callback test.

validation.host_test_scope: synthetic mock of registration, dispatch and unregister; no real engine

known_blockers: No matching authorized native client source project is present for Dungeon Quest.
The prototype Java class is not in the game DEX and no post-engineInitialize callsite is wired.
The correct engine-owning thread and exact callback lifecycle for this target build remain unverified.
Direct dispatcher invocation does not prove a HUD/AIM serialized action can call the registered function.
